UI_SQSearch_Integrate: Integrate with existing inventory search fields
UI_SQSearch_IntegrateTip: On by default. The sandbox handling mode selects all queries (default) or special syntax only. Category mode follows the existing interface.
UI_SQSearch_ClickPopup: Open enhanced search on left-click in a search field
UI_SQSearch_ClickPopupTip: Off by default. Requires search-field integration. Carries over the text and inventory or nearby scope.
UI_SQSearch_OpenKeyTip: F8 by default. Rebind here. The global shortcut pauses while entering text.
UI_SQSearch_ShowCounts: Show container hit counts and matching stack counts
UI_SQSearch_ShowHelp: Expand usage hints when first opening the panel
UI_SQSearch_PinyinTip: Uses an enabled Pinyin Search mod for item names, combined categories and source display names. Supports full spelling and initials regardless of case. Literal matching works independently.
UI_SQSearch_Help: Names and source display names support partial matching regardless of ASCII case, whitespace, hyphens and underscores. With Pinyin Search enabled, NIUROUBING and NRB both match 牛肉饼; M110BQ matches M110 步枪. <LINE> Space-separated terms must all match the same item. <LINE> @"Mod Name" brewing -book searches that mod and excludes books. <LINE> &Chinesecuisine.BrewingBook34 matches the complete item ID exactly. <LINE> wrench | hammer matches either group. Spaces take precedence over |. <LINE> Use double quotes for phrases with spaces. @vanilla finds vanilla items. <LINE> Matching groups appear first by default. Purple outlines and original yellow search highlights mark hits; selection/hover retain their backgrounds. 2/5 means two matching items in that stack. Nearby includes currently accessible, explored containers and visible floor items. <LINE> Options > Mod Options > SuQing's Search Enhancement contains integration, click-to-open and shortcut settings. <LINE> Sandbox Options > SuQing's Search Enhancement > Existing search-field handling defaults to all searches. Special-only mode leaves ordinary field input native; @, &, -, |, quotes and whitespace AND activate enhancement. The F8 panel always enhances searches.
UI_SQSearch_Empty: Enter a query to mark results in the existing item lists
UI_SQSearch_Native: Using the existing search field; edit here to refine the query
UI_SQSearch_Count: %1 matching items · marked in item lists and container tabs
UI_SQSearch_ErrorEmptyOr: Enter a search group on both sides of |
UI_SQSearch_ErrorUnclosedQuote: Close the double quote at the end of the phrase
UI_SQSearch_SortMatches: Move matching results to the top
UI_SQSearch_SortMatchesTip: On by default. Matching groups appear first in the actual display list, preserving order within both groups and following filter/sort changes. Clearing restores native order. Reordering waits during dragging or marquee selection.
UI_SQSearch_ContextMenuTip: Off by default. Show the Search Enhancement entry in inventory context menus. F8 and integrated search fields work independently.
